description: This file defines the CORSHeaders class, which manages Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers for HTTP requests and responses within the mockserver project. It includes methods for adding CORS headers based on request properties and configuration.

classes.name: CORSHeaders
classes.description: Class responsible for handling CORS headers in HTTP requests and responses, including adding appropriate headers based on configuration and request details.

methods.name: CORSHeaders
methods.description: Constructor initializing CORS headers with specific configuration parameters.

methods.name: CORSHeaders
methods.description: Constructor initializing CORS headers from a Configuration object.

methods.name: isPreflightRequest
methods.description: Static method to determine if a request is a CORS preflight OPTIONS request and enable CORS for API if true.

methods.name: addCORSHeaders
methods.description: Method to add CORS headers to an HTTP response based on the request and current configuration.

methods.name: setHeaderIfNotAlreadyExists
methods.description: Private helper method to set a header on the response if it does not already exist.
